pages.title: Wormhole Throat
pages.text: The narrowest point of an Einstein-Rosen bridge, where two regions of spacetime are joined. Normally it pinches off faster than light can cross it, but exotic matter can hold it open. Looking into it, I can see a distant place in miniature.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Causality Loop Engine I sent a Wormhole Throat back along a Closed Timelike Curve with Chronon Gas, so that it arrived before it was opened. There were two. I am not sure which one I built.

Made in $(item)Causality Loop Engine$() and $(item)Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Traversable Wormholes.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Closed Timelike Curve, Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector, Entangled Transceiver, Miniature Wormhole, Paradox Residue, Spacetime Singularity, Unified Notes I, Wormhole Throat.
